string_preview: Reduced hydraulic actuator transition model dataset: history of valve, pressure, cylinder and mechanical states to next cylinder-extension and pressure increments.
Force is saved separately and is not part of the core 26-dimensional ROM input.
Input window ends at timestep k. The target describes the transition from k to k+1.
